about_short_description.short_description: Invofox is an AI tool that fully automates document data extraction without requiring any human intervention.

product.name: Invofox API
product.description: An API that converts unstructured documents into structured JSON data by extracting, validating, and autocompleting fields using AI models and proprietary algorithms.

product.name: Custom Docs
product.description: A service that processes any document type by converting unstructured data into verified, structured outputs with customizable validation rules.

product.name: Data Verification
product.description: A solution that extracts, validates, and verifies data from documents using AI and programmatic rules to ensure high accuracy and data quality.

product.name: Invoice OCR
product.description: An AI-powered OCR service that extracts and verifies invoice data from various formats, enabling automated invoice processing and integration with financial systems.

product.name: Utility Bill OCR
product.description: An AI-based OCR service that extracts and verifies data from utility bills, supporting automated processing and integration with accounting systems.
